verdict.rationale: Obsidian's evidence covers plugins, URI triggers, sync, and manual note-taking features, but nothing describes a scheduler, background task runner, or autonomous automation engine that could operate without user interaction. The plugin system (obsidian-docs-7, obsidian-docs-33) is user-invoked, and Restricted Mode (obsidian-docs-27) even limits unattended code execution, so there's no documented path to autonomous background automations.
